# LASU routing identity regression

`source-regeneration-lasu.json.gz` contains a public path and routing subset of the archived published package `lasu-4895a363b403` and candidate `lasu-38c1d9f23165` from the [12 October 2026 source check](https://github.com/mrglasswillbreak/TurnRight/actions/runs/38227965373). The embedded provenance includes hashes of the original public JSON packages.

Both packages contain 95 paths. Twenty path geometries differ. Rebuilt routing segment identities must never be counted as deleted upstream paths. Geometry, endpoint identities and explicit `parentEdgeIds` are retained; unrelated places and map content are omitted.

Attribution: OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0, and the existing [TurnRight data sources](../../../data/ATTRIBUTION.md). This fixture contains no private workspace export. The independently authorized private replay reads an ignored local export under `data/candidates/source-audit-2026-10-13/` and is skipped when that private evidence is unavailable.
